choice_points.label: Follow Fang’s lead. Watch what she’s watching.
Don’t wait to find out. Signal a halt.
Keep them moving, close ranks. Signal Berke to tighten the line.
Turn and slow them down yourself. Buy Fang the lead.
Overturn a stall behind you. Make them go around.
Duck through the tannery’s side door and lose them in the yards.
"I had your back. You had mine."
"...Yeah. Let’s keep moving."
"Don't make it a thing."
"That's not an answer."
(nod. don't press. drink the tea.)
(nice weather, isn't it, Fang?)
Tell her. Now.
Keep watching. She gave you the rock; give her the slope.
Test him. Let your hand drift to your blade and see if he reacts.
Stand with the animals. The herders are the ones who cannot fight.
Get back to Fang. She saw it first; she will see it coming.
Find scree. If it comes, you want something to throw before it reaches you.
Reach for the scree. Put the camel between the vampire and the merchant.
Get your body between the merchant and the vampire.

audit.message: Passages with no <<soctrack "scene_enter">>: drop-off and dwell are invisible here unless a generic passage event is added.
scene_enter detail differs from the passage name, so queries keyed on passage name will miss these.
Passages nothing links to (may be reached by loader jumps, scripts, or be dead).
Relationship-style variables that change during play but are not in WATCHED_STATS, so changes go unlogged.
Relationship-style variables declared but never changed in this build; watch them before they start changing.
consentmoment logs a single string ('id / stat=delta'); offered options, the chosen option and decline are not sent.
Macros defined in Story JavaScript but not called from any passage in this build.
Passages over 150 KB (usually embedded base64 media); slow on mobile, worth an asset_load check.
